egressOwner: legacy variant: per-output MemoryQueue + dedicated sender thread (RESTREAM_EGRESS_FABRIC unset). fabric variant: SrtShardBackend with native UDP multiplexer-port reuse (RESTREAM_EGRESS_FABRIC=srt).
comparison: N=500 was chosen deliberately: legacy SRT egress has a hardcoded semaphore capping concurrent sender threads at 512 (src/media/srt_egress.rs:212, already documented as a removal target), so 500 is close to legacy's own architectural ceiling without exceeding it -- the highest scale at which a fair like-for-like comparison is even possible. At this scale the smoke-scale N=10/N=30 captures' fabric-is-worse signal fully reverses: fabric CPU avg is 171.0% vs legacy's 196.76% (~13% *lower*), and RSS avg is 922,130KB vs legacy's 1,052,797KB (~12% *lower*). Both variants delivered all 500 outputs to progress within timeout. mediamtx logged 'decode error' WARN lines in both variants (legacy 2,621, fabric 762) and restream logged 'egress feed overrun: leaf resynchronized' in both -- both are the pre-existing, documented, benign single-connection ramp-up resync mechanism (each new output's leaf briefly lags the shared ring during ramp before its first real visit catches it up), not a fabric-introduced regression -- legacy shows *more* of these warnings than fabric, not fewer.
scope: The highest scale at which legacy and fabric can be fairly compared side by side, given legacy's own hard 512-output cap. See the sibling vps-6cpu-12gb-n1000-fabric-only/ directory for proof fabric clears that cap entirely (legacy cannot be run at N=1000 at all -- it stalls permanently at 512 and never reaches progress).
deviations: Isolated lifecycle (one mediamtx+restream stack per variant, not shared); single measurement point per variant rather than a growth curve; single host sample, not a multi-run statistical distribution; no RcvQ/SndQ native thread-count sampling.
